correctness.rationale: For fixed n≥2 and Ω_n>0, F=z+Ω_n a z^n has exact defect (n−1)w/(1+w), w=Ω_n a z^(n−1). On |w|<t, t<1, its supremum is (n−1)t/(1−t); t≥1 creates interior zero or boundary divergence. Equality at target disk boundary is allowed since |z|<1. Thus transformed membership iff |a|≤δ/[Ω_n(n−1+δ)]. Original derivative 1+naz^(n−1) has an interior zero iff |a|>1/n; for |a|≤1/n, Re[(1+nu)/(1+u)]>0 throughout disk, including equality boundary. Hence exact monomial inverse-safe cutoff δ_n=Ω_n(n−1)/(n−Ω_n); since Ω_n∼(n−1)^(−λ/2−μ)→0 for λ,μ>0, for every δ∈(0,1] a high n yields a non-locally univalent preimage. Symbolic thresholds independently checked at multiple n,λ,μ, but infinite conclusion is analytic, not inferred from samples.
